name: Rebirth
source:
REBIRTH is a world full of lore and a unique cast of characters, some stunning and beautiful, like the woman who kidnaps you, and others… not so beautiful.
But when you're pulled into a vicious and unforgiving world as a newly fledged vampire, you will have to survive – and there are many ways to die.

Your choices and actions determine how successful you will be, and affect how your powers grow, and which direction they go in. Along your journey, you will have the option to romance multiple, gorgeous women, though going after them all may have consequences! But it’s your choice.

[Edited from [url=https://likesblondes.itch.io/rebirth]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《Rebirth》的世界拥有丰富的背景设定，以及一群各具特色的角色。其中一些美艳动人，比如绑架你的那个女人；另一些则…没那么好看。
然而，当你作为一名刚刚转化的吸血鬼，被卷入这个凶险无情的世界时，你必须设法活下来——而死法却有很多。

你的选择与行动决定了你能取得多大的成就，也会影响你的力量如何成长、朝哪个方向发展。在旅途中，你可以选择与多名美丽的女性发展恋情，不过，若想将她们全部追到手，或许就得承担相应的后果！但选择权在你手中。

[根据[url=https://likesblondes.itch.io/rebirth]Itch.io[/url]编辑整理]
